title: Quán khuya
about: Round x8, in directions of my own choosing, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm nhiều bài nữa, hướng bạn tự đề xuất"): dark lofi: the last café open in the rain-dark city, the felt piano's chords on a slow beat, a deep bass, the old music box humming a tune now and then. D minor at 76 bpm. An original piece.
